content.text: In an era where conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal restrict access for creators in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela, building a [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-11|COREMERCH guide to github]].io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-11|crypto]] store on Cloudflare Pages offers a powerful solution. With a complete infrastructure stack, you can operate your digital storefront without relying on those traditional services. This guide will walk you through the process, from setup to deployment, ensuring you have [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-guide-4|Everything About]] needed to get your store live and accepting crypto payments seamlessly.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment platforms often fail to service creators in various regions due to geopolitical restrictions and financial isolation. By utilizing infrastructure like Cloudflare Pages, you escape the limitations imposed by these platforms. You control your digital store, using crypto payments that are not only secure but also accessible across borders. This level of sovereignty ensures that your business remains operational despite the disruptions faced by conventional systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your Cloudflare Pages store, gather the necessary tools and resources. You will need a domain name to establish your online presence, a Cloudflare account for hosting, and access to NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Additionally, familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend logic. Having these components in place will streamline your setup process and ensure a smooth deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your payment processing with NOWPayments. Create an account and generate your API keys for integration. Next, set up Google Apps Script to handle order management and product delivery automatically. This script will ensure that once a payment is confirmed on-chain, the digital product is delivered instantly. This pipeline guarantees that your customers receive their purchases without delays, enhancing their shopping experience.
Build your crypto store without reliance on traditional payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery systems are in place, it's time to go live. Test your infrastructure thoroughly by processing a few test transactions to ensure everything works as intended. Verify that payments are processed via NOWPayments and products are delivered correctly. After confirming successful transactions, promote your store to your audience and encourage them to make purchases. Your crypto store is now operational and ready to accept payments.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store live and operational, consider strategies for scaling your business. Leverage the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to expand your capabilities, allowing you to add more products and enhance your backend with features like Supabase integration. Monitor performance and user engagement to understand which products resonate with your audience. By staying proactive, you can ensure your infrastructure grows alongside your business.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Your infrastructure is yours alone; no subscriptions or dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for an advanced setup, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for quicker deployment and enhanced features. Explore more about available products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This will provide you with a comprehensive view of what you can build without the limitations of traditional payment networks.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does NOWPayments work with my store?

NOWPayments processes cryptocurrency payments without requiring KYC or buyer accounts. You simply integrate their API into your store, and once payments are confirmed on-chain, your customers receive their products instantly.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a simpler setup using GitHub Pages and Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours for deployment. In contrast, Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for a more robust solution deployed in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent choices for hosting digital product stores. They provide the necessary infrastructure to operate without relying on traditional payment processors.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse customer base. You can choose low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON for efficient transactions.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 02?
Stack 02 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. This includes a fully configured environment with end-to-end testing before handoff, ensuring you have a reliable setup.
